title: Specific heat from slope
statement:
Identical masses of two solids receive heat at the same rate with no phase change. Solid X warms more slowly. Which conclusion follows?

[_]{a}

choices: X has the greater specific heat.
X has the smaller specific heat.
Both must have the same specific heat.
explanations: More heat is needed per gram per degree.
The prompt rules out a phase change.

hints: Mass and heating rate are the same.
Compare ΔT for the same input heat.
solution: $dT/dt=(dq/dt)/(mc)$, so higher $c$ means slower warming under these conditions.
